result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has two identical restaurant cards and a truncated restaurant name, which makes the content look broken or poorly prepared.

issues.description: Two consecutive 'Green Bowl Poké' cards in the 'Fastest near you' section are identical (same image, name, delivery fee, and time), making the list appear duplicated or buggy.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the list or add distinguishing details such as branch name, distance, or a unique promo so the duplicate entries look intentional.

issues.description: The third card title in the 'Fastest near you' section reads 'Smash Bros Bu' because the restaurant name is cut off without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis or increase the available title width so long names are clearly truncated (e.g., 'Smash Bros Bu...').

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in the 'Popular right now' list is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its title and details.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or safe-area inset so the last list item is fully visible above the tab bar when scrolling.
